title: SIPPO — a bubble tea brand with a pixel smile
seo_title: SIPPO Bubble Tea Brand Identity | Muhammad Babar
description: Brand identity case study for SIPPO bubble tea: a pixel wordmark, a mascot with three moods, a lime and pink palette, and packaging, merch and a shopfront.
summary: A playful identity for a bubble tea brand: a pixel wordmark, a mascot with three moods and a loud lime and pink palette, carried from cup sleeves to the shopfront.
